patches.title: Extend native screen splitting to top and bottom
patches.reason: Share one private split predicate across all existing splitDirection consumers, retaining native left/right values, image-only alpha masking and shadow-map exclusions. A drawing-buffer Y coordinate adds top/bottom support without new resources or passes.
patches.removalCondition: Native splitting supports equivalent top/bottom directions across all existing consumers.

patches.title: Preserve near-field precision in globe polygon clipping
patches.reason: Rebase distance-field inputs before Float32 packing and evaluate spherical clipping from interpolated RTC positions instead of rounded world positions and interpolated angles.
patches.removalCondition: Native globe polygon clipping preserves sub-meter coordinates through packing, distance-field generation and per-fragment terrain evaluation.

patches.title: Prepare cached shader programs without blocking link-status queries
patches.reason: ADR-0190 lets environment cloud programs poll KHR completion while native ShaderProgram retains linking, reflection, cache and pending-handle ownership.
patches.removalCondition: Native ShaderProgram provides equivalent cached asynchronous preparation and pending resource cleanup.

patches.title: Route native model polygon clipping through planar XY regions
patches.reason: Native clipping polygon packing, tile intersection and model shaders assume spherical coordinates. An owned adapter reuses planar terrain edge evaluation while retaining native Model and tileset collection ownership.
patches.removalCondition: Native clipping polygons support equivalent planar Cartesian coordinates, tile bounds and model fragment evaluation.

patches.title: Reuse native EntityCluster in planar worlds
patches.reason: ADR-0183 supplies an instance-local planar visibility and invalidation policy without ellipsoid occlusion or cartographic-height history. Native pools, screen-space clustering, events and the default globe path remain shared.
patches.removalCondition: Native EntityCluster provides an equivalent instance-local spatial policy suitable for planar worlds.

patches.title: Integrate independent observer viewshed selection and capture
patches.reason: ADR-0177 shares the observer coordinator between Viewshed and VideoProjection. ADR-0176 delegates observer capture to owned helpers, exposes native terrain command generation and scales tile SSE to an explicit observer viewport. Default rendering remains unchanged when no analysis is registered.
patches.removalCondition: Native Scene supports independent analysis views with shared terrain and tile resources, explicit view resolution and preserved main-view state.

patches.title: Maintain conservative bounds for explicit model flatten shaders
patches.reason: Native CustomShader changes mesh positions without updating tile or draw-command bounds. Delegate conservative bounds to the owned SceneGISModelFlatten instance, preserving source bounds and default paths.
patches.removalCondition: Native CustomShader supports conservative deformation bounds for tile traversal and all derived draw commands.

patches.title: Integrate optional HDR color grading with native tone curves
patches.reason: White balance and grading must consume exposed linear HDR before native compression without an additional color pass. ADR-0169 also feeds the active environment's fixed solar white point through the existing Context-aware grading hook, after selecting the HDR or LDR display source; LDR uses the same owned function without an extra pass.
patches.removalCondition: Native tone mapping offers equivalent linear HDR grading and explicit controller lifecycle.

patches.title: Apply optional weather coverage before forward surface lighting
patches.reason: Wetness and snow must modify native material inputs before lighting and MRT capture, with explicit Scene scheduling and lifetime.
patches.removalCondition: Native Scene exposes equivalent material coverage integration before all supported lighting consumers.

patches.title: Integrate optional histogram eye adaptation with native tone mapping
patches.reason: Global metering needs pre-tone-map HDR and a GPU exposure divisor without an extra full-resolution color pass.
patches.removalCondition: Native post processing exposes equivalent histogram metering, time-based adaptation and explicit lifecycle.

patches.title: Capture and compose bounded screen-space indirect diffuse lighting
patches.reason: SSIL needs diffuse source and material response from the main draw, with explicit Scene scheduling and lifecycle; final-color postprocessing cannot separate these terms.
patches.removalCondition: Native Scene exposes equivalent single-pass diffuse transport data and bounded screen-space indirect lighting.

patches.title: Apply optional geometric specular antialiasing before model lighting
patches.reason: PBR needs unperturbed geometry derivatives after custom material evaluation and before direct, IBL, clearcoat and SSR consumers; public postprocessing cannot filter material lobes.
patches.removalCondition: Native PBR exposes equivalent optional geometry-normal filtering shared by all specular consumers.

patches.title: Integrate explicitly captured local environment probes
patches.reason: Local probe capture needs a normal-frame scheduling seam and position-aware environment radiance/visibility before native material weighting.
patches.removalCondition: Native Scene and PBR expose equivalent bounded, explicitly updated geometry probes with environment-only occlusion.

patches.title: Keep model normals finite for singular texture coordinates
patches.reason: Bistro railings contain zero-area UV triangles without tangents; native derivative tangent division produces NaNs and white speckles. Preserve geometry normals only where the UV frame is singular.
patches.removalCondition: Native material normal mapping handles singular derivative UV frames without non-finite base, clearcoat or anisotropic normals.

patches.title: Avoid identical floating uniform array uploads
patches.reason: Native array caches compare JS doubles with Float32 values, repeatedly uploading unchanged cloud, lighting and cascade arrays. Owned packed-bit comparison preserves exact GPU values.
patches.removalCondition: Native floating uniform array comparison avoids duplicate uploads after Float32 packing.

patches.title: Record native PBR IBL responses for screen-space reflections
patches.reason: SSR needs native IBL direction and BRDF weighting in shared screen lighting. The deferred pipeline keeps the SCENEGIS_SSR_MAIN recorders and removes the obsolete standalone capture and forward receiver branches.
patches.removalCondition: Native Scene supports equivalent forward material capture, current-frame SSR and per-lobe PBR radiance integration.

patches.title: Connect shared HDR physical sky reflections to native PBR
patches.reason: Native procedural RGBA8 captures use a different atmosphere and model-oriented reflection frame; physical HDR sky needs direct mip rendering and a default IBL source seam. Preserve Model > Scene > procedural source precedence and live source replacement (backported from 122ba3dd1d).
patches.removalCondition: Retire when native physical sky IBL offers equivalent HDR mip capture, explicit-source precedence and world-fixed reflection directions.

patches.title: Integrate current-frame ambient occlusion into indirect lighting
patches.reason: Native final-color AO cannot preserve direct light, emissive and atmosphere. Shared screen lighting records indirect energy separately; the deferred pipeline removes the old geometry prepass and standalone opaque AO receiver while retaining the indirect recorders. ADR-0184 adds optional directional environment visibility at native base/clearcoat IBL while preserving scalar diffuse AO and SSR replacement semantics.
patches.removalCondition: Native renderer provides current-frame AO and compatible per-material indirect-light integration.

patches.title: Integrate stable directional cascades and precise shadow filtering
patches.reason: Retain native shadow resources and APIs while dispatching non-ellipsoid visibility, stable Globe/Planar cascades, geometric receiver-plane correction and continuous atlas-safe PCF to owned code. Reused Globe commands invalidate their receive variant when terrain vertex-normal availability changes, even when the base material shader is unchanged.
patches.removalCondition: Retire when native shadows and terrain controls support equivalent non-ellipsoid world semantics and stable cascades with explicit surface metadata.

patches.title: Connect optional SceneGIS physical lighting to native model PBR
patches.reason: Native model PBR has no current-frame source hook for SceneGIS physical irradiance and Beer cloud transmittance; final-color relighting would incorrectly attenuate emissive and indirect light.
patches.removalCondition: Retire when native Model offers equivalent optional physical direct/diffuse source and cloud transmittance hooks with frame-local resources and variant lifecycle.

patches.title: Add primary world lifecycle and integration slots
patches.reason: Scene and CesiumWidget currently route primary-world lifecycle and DataSource visualization exclusively through Globe-oriented defaults, so a non-Globe world cannot participate without impersonating Globe. ADR-0185 also accepts an explicit optional false terrain-depth policy on non-Globe worlds, retaining the native classification and depth-clear order without a spherical DepthPlane.
patches.removalCondition: Retire when upstream Scene and CesiumWidget expose equivalent mutually exclusive primary-world construction, lifecycle, and world-aware per-instance DataSource visualization contracts.

patches.title: Add primary-world environment render slot
patches.reason: Scene's environment pass has no structural slot for procedural environment content owned by a non-Globe primary world.
patches.removalCondition: Retire when upstream Scene exposes an equivalent optional primary-world environment render slot before ordinary geometry.

patches.title: Add planar Viewer integration
patches.reason: Viewer currently constructs Globe-oriented widgets, navigation, and entity camera behavior without a planar-world construction and ownership path.
patches.removalCondition: Retire when upstream Viewer exposes an equivalent planar-world construction path, controller ownership lifecycle, planar Home integration, and compatible widget capability guards.

patches.title: Add planar Camera view and flight dispatch
patches.reason: Camera view, flight, world-target orientation, orthographic scale, changed events and pick rays require explicit fixed-axis and four-frustum dispatch for a live planar primary world instead of ellipsoid ENU or Cartographic height.
patches.removalCondition: Retire when upstream Camera exposes equivalent non-ellipsoid fixed-axis view, framing, Cartesian flight, and external controller input-suspension hooks for a custom primary world.

patches.title: Add planar Entity, DataSource and tileset framing dispatch
patches.reason: CesiumWidget and Viewer currently normalize zoom targets through Globe-specific overloads and share mutable completion state, while planar Entity and native planar-coordinate tileset framing require an exact target profile, current bounds, isolated operation lifecycle, and zoom-only InfoBox behavior.
patches.removalCondition: Retire when upstream CesiumWidget and Viewer expose equivalent custom-world Entity/DataSource/planar-tileset target validation, operation-isolated zoom lifecycle, and configurable zoom-only InfoBox camera behavior.

patches.title: Add planar Entity tracking dispatch
patches.reason: CesiumWidget and Viewer route Entity tracking through ellipsoid EntityView semantics, while a planar primary world requires fixed-axis tracking, ControllerHost camera authority, and operation-isolated framing interaction.
patches.removalCondition: Retire when upstream CesiumWidget and Viewer expose equivalent custom-world fixed-axis Entity tracking, controller-authority coordination, and configurable InfoBox/double-click tracking behavior.

patches.title: Add non-Globe Scene API and native-effect safety
patches.reason: Scene height/clamp APIs and native Earth environment effects silently retain ellipsoid or Globe semantics for a non-Globe primary world, so Scene needs explicit capability guards at API and frame boundaries.
patches.removalCondition: Retire when upstream Scene exposes equivalent primary-world-aware height/clamp capability reporting and pre-frame native environment effect validation for non-Globe worlds.

patches.title: Add advanced environment background, celestial ordering, and HDR render slots
patches.reason: Scene has no optional scene-wide slot that can render an advanced environment for both Globe and non-Globe worlds before native celestial bodies and geometry, then composite resolved scene color and depth before built-in bloom and tone mapping.
patches.removalCondition: Retire when upstream Scene exposes equivalent optional pre-celestial/pre-geometry advanced-environment and pre-tone-mapping resolved color/depth extension slots with explicit lifecycle ownership and native celestial ordering.

patches.title: Add optional SceneGIS Globe surface lighting seam
patches.reason: Cesium Globe surface shaders have no explicit frame-local extension seam for a caller-owned physical Sun/sky irradiance source and volumetric Beer cloud transmittance, while post-process relighting would incorrectly light already shaded scene primitives. ADR-0167 adds one warm nightAmbientIntensity uniform to the existing GlobeSurfaceTileProvider map; the irradiance-driven ambient floor remains SceneGIS-owned.
patches.removalCondition: Retire when upstream Globe surface rendering exposes an equivalent optional frame-local material-lighting extension with shader-source and uniform ownership hooks.

patches.title: Declare the independent vector-tile style frontend dependency
patches.reason: SceneGIS vector tiles require an independently versioned style validator and expression frontend, separate from Cesium experimental MVT support.

files.reason: JSON dependency declarations and license-generator input cannot contain paired comments.
JSON dependency declarations and license-generator input cannot contain paired comments.

patches.removalCondition: Retire if the independent style frontend dependency is removed or upstream declares the exact required dependency and delivery metadata.

patches.title: Allow direct vector overlays on a translucent Globe surface
patches.reason: Native translucent classification multiplies vector color by Globe alpha. An explicit owner slot keeps direct surface vectors independent using the native depth peel. Above-surface direct overlays respect Globe.showSkirts in the borrowed depth-only peel, reusing existing skirt indices to close native translucent tile seams without changing color commands or adding draws.
patches.removalCondition: Retire when upstream exposes an equivalent optional direct surface overlay stage with independent color opacity and native depth/pick lifecycle.

patches.title: Compose local water after opaque geometry
patches.reason: Local water requires a non-water opaque snapshot and per-frustum transmission composition before translucent geometry.
patches.removalCondition: Retire when upstream exposes equivalent opaque capture and per-frustum water composition hooks.

patches.title: Apply geometric shadows to direct illumination
patches.reason: Native final-color shadow modulation darkens indirect illumination and emission after material composition. Share the existing visibility before lighting with explicit material receivers.
patches.removalCondition: Retire when upstream shadow receivers provide equivalent direct-light visibility before material and atmospheric composition.

patches.title: Add bounded local lighting before material composition
patches.reason: Native Scene has one directional light; shared point and spot lighting requires explicit forward material seams and color-command scheduling.
patches.removalCondition: Retire when upstream supports equivalent Scene-owned punctual lighting at native material stages with matching lifecycle and coordinate semantics.

patches.title: Preserve HDR radiance through native bloom
patches.reason: Native bloom uses unsigned-byte intermediate targets before HDR tone mapping, clipping emission and quantizing night gradients. Floating-point extraction also requires nonnegative RGB.
patches.removalCondition: Retire when native bloom preserves scene HDR precision and nonnegative extracted light through its intermediates.

patches.title: Add optional render projection jitter and temporal resolve
patches.reason: Temporal antialiasing needs render-only projection and per-frustum main depth before HDR postprocessing without changing Camera or replaying geometry.
patches.removalCondition: Native Scene provides equivalent temporal antialiasing and render-only projection/depth hooks.

patches.title: Report native heightmap upsampling readiness
patches.reason: Native Globe traversal can visit missing descendants before a received heightmap parent has a mesh. Expose the existing canUpsample contract so the terrain state machine advances that parent instead of indefinitely deferring its children.
patches.removalCondition: Native HeightmapTerrainData reports mesh readiness to GlobeSurfaceTile before upsampling, as QuantizedMeshTerrainData already does.

patches.title: Qualify native WebGL material buffers
patches.reason: Deferred capture records native material values and point-center eye coordinates before lighting overwrites diffuse. The inspector borrows the main material targets instead of replaying geometry. Narrow native hooks retain clipping-edge and silhouette unlit colors, primitive outline coverage, discard, transparency and picking while owned code stores and restores optional material extensions. Initialize native planar-fill fragment depth before both the feature-ID pre-pass and color pass when LOG_DEPTH is absent; preserve post-material model stages and capture their final biased depth. Preserve final native edge-visibility color as an unlit deferred overlay without replaying the surface. Decode native packed edge depth with the active orthographic or perspective projection. The unified native-channel contract is recorded in ADR-0161. Resolve native planar-fill depth ties against the existing feature-ID pre-pass depth within measured raster subpixel and depth24 precision before native ordering, preventing TAA jitter from changing coplanar visibility without new textures or geometry draws.
patches.removalCondition: Native rendering exposes equivalent material outputs and inspector lifecycle, or deferred material inspection is retired.

patches.title: Integrate Scene-owned native-material deferred WebGL lighting
patches.reason: Scene owns a default single-sample deferred renderer with explicit WebGL2/3D profile validation. Material-only native variants and Scene scheduling preserve surface depth across Globe clears, native and inverse classification, cached Tiles depth ownership, cross-frustum material collection, one lighting resolve, depth restoration for dedicated transparency, staged translucent Globe classification, and shared final water depth for temporal and environment effects. Display HDR is independent of linear deferred storage; the native tone-mapping slot supplies gamma-only LDR output without exposure. Scene, CesiumWidget and Viewer document the same single-sample default. Obsolete opaque AO/SSR receiver and geometry-capture scheduling is removed; their existing outputs consume deferred material and screen-lighting data. Native billboard and label coverage is separated before culling: solid colors run in a dedicated per-frustum tail with unblended depth MRT, while fractional backgrounds and glyph edges reuse native transparency. Conditional annotation depth serves occlusion and final temporal depth; physical water refraction inputs exclude annotations. Native voxel color runs after water and truncates its view ray against final opaque, annotation and water linear depth without material capture or geometry replay. Reuse TAA or water final depth; otherwise activate the owner-approved conditional R32F and one initialization copy for visible water plus voxel, including a single frustum. The scene contract and budget are recorded in ADR-0161. Native voxel picking runs after opaque pick IDs and refreshes the existing packed depth only for frusta with voxel pick commands, preserving front-surface occlusion without borrowing temporal color depth or adding color-frame resources. The owner excludes native visual fog, atmosphere and Globe daylight from deferred compatibility: gate their Scene/Globe preparation while retaining caller objects and fog culling; scene.environmentEffects exposes a Scene-owned lightweight advanced default with caller-owned controller precedence, world-bound teardown, and deferred cloud resources. Multi-frustum position picking replaces the native depth copy with an owned copy combining the current segment of retained opaque linear depth and final hardware depth, avoiding stale packed Globe depth after the split lighting schedule; it reuses native pick targets and adds no copy or geometry submission. Owner-approved transparent Planar maps use explicit preparation, classification and transparency hooks: one whole-view nearest-terrain depth capture, ordered maps in a mutually exclusive color target, and composition in existing transparent terrain draws; native picking writes actual surface depth. The owned helper stays within ADR-0073 and ADR-0161 budgets. P4g retains diagnostic tint after deferred lighting, routes skip-LOD stencil clears to their actual material target, and places native vector classification wireframe in a dedicated unlit tail. Recursive post-process updates preserve displayHdr on the first LDR frame. The owner-approved SCENEGIS_VECTOR pass separates opaque map extrusion capture from external object depth, retains one deferred light resolve, and composes ordered vector symbols and translucent buildings across frusta. Conditional depth snapshots avoid external geometry replay; vector pick IDs retain native terrain visibility and record current-pick external and building depth in the original draws. Post-process selection includes the dedicated vector ID pass. Empty command views clear native depth and stencil once before screen consumers, so postprocessing cannot observe the previous frame after the frustum list becomes empty. ADR-0171 moves the Scene.msaaSamples patch markers outside JSDoc so strict release documentation accepts the unchanged default.
patches.removalCondition: Native rendering provides equivalent deferred material lighting, or the private experiment is retired.

patches.title: Keep tiled local lighting out of shadow casters
patches.reason: Pass explicit shadow-cast execution context so color receivers do not derive local-light shaders for shadow geometry.
patches.removalCondition: Native command scheduling exposes equivalent explicit color-receiver eligibility.

patches.title: Capture native feature styling for deferred lighting
patches.reason: Preserve the native per-feature post-lighting color multiplier across material capture and fullscreen lighting without storing pick IDs or changing feature APIs.
patches.removalCondition: Native rendering exposes equivalent post-lighting style capture, or the private deferred experiment is retired.

patches.title: Capture native Primitive Phong materials for deferred lighting
patches.reason: Explicitly identify native lit appearances and ray-cast EllipsoidPrimitive, capture weather-adjusted Phong material before lighting, and preserve explicit intersection depth and sun-only lighting while retaining geometry, batching and picking APIs.
patches.removalCondition: Native rendering exposes equivalent Primitive material capture, or the private deferred experiment is retired.

patches.title: Initialize dynamic Entity color geometry with an opaque base state
patches.reason: DynamicGeometryUpdater changes off-ground translucency after constructing PerInstanceColorAppearance; a translucent base state incorrectly keeps blending enabled on opaque commands. Start off-ground geometry opaque and let native getRenderState enable blending for actual translucent alpha; preserve ground defaults.
patches.removalCondition: Native dynamic Entity color appearance initializes blending consistently with its actual translucency.

patches.title: Submit native Globe imagery as deferred surface material
patches.reason: Capture imagery, Fabric, terrain and ocean material before lighting, preserving clipping and unlit overlays; reserve surface and companion-transparency lighting samplers, and submit native wave normals and water masks without evaluating illumination in the material pass.
patches.removalCondition: Native rendering exposes equivalent Globe material submission, or the deferred pipeline is retired.

patches.title: Accept native two-channel color framebuffer attachments
patches.reason: PixelFormat already validates and allocates RG textures, but isColorFormat omits RG and rejects their use as framebuffer color attachments.
patches.removalCondition: Native PixelFormat.isColorFormat accepts the existing RG color format.

patches.title: Preserve depth-clamped classification volumes in logarithmic frustums
patches.reason: Automatic logarithmic depth derivation discards out-of-frustum fragments even when the source shader requests depth clamp, opening classification volumes and removing ground coverage and picks. Clamp the automatic log-depth argument only for depth-clamped shaders; retain ordinary discard and explicit depth-writer ownership.
patches.removalCondition: Native log-depth command derivation preserves source depth-clamp semantics.

patches.title: Release tileset-owned Gaussian resources on tileset destruction
patches.reason: GaussianSplat3DTileContent creates one shared GaussianSplatPrimitive on its tileset, but tileset destruction does not release that primitive. Invoke its existing destroy during tileset teardown, including collection removal and Scene destruction, and clear the ownership reference. Preserve single-tile unloading and callers that already released the private primitive.
patches.removalCondition: Native Cesium3DTileset destruction releases its shared GaussianSplatPrimitive.

patches.title: Route translucent-only point collections through the translucent pass
patches.reason: PointPrimitiveCollection labels BlendOption.TRANSLUCENT commands as OPAQUE despite disabled depth writes and enabled blending. Select the pass from the actual opaque-command flag so translucent points use native forward OIT or sorted transparency and opaque points retain deferred material capture.
patches.removalCondition: Native PointPrimitiveCollection assigns BlendOption.TRANSLUCENT commands to Pass.TRANSLUCENT.

patches.title: Capture independent point cloud material before vertex lighting
patches.reason: TimeDynamicPointCloud uses the independent PointCloud producer. Expose its styled color and decoded eye-space normal to deferred capture while retaining native forward lighting for translucent points, clipping edge color, style and picking.
patches.removalCondition: Native independent PointCloud provides an equivalent deferred material interface.

patches.title: Register point EDL depth with the deferred renderer
patches.reason: Keep original opaque point material commands and register their EDL processor instead of redirecting lit color into the native framebuffer. The scene-owned deferred renderer captures one private point depth per visible command and applies EDL within lighting. Release the dedicated depth when the native processor is destroyed. Destroy the EDL processor when its owning tileset or dynamic point cloud is destroyed; both native owners omit this release.
patches.removalCondition: Native point EDL supports deferred lighting with equivalent private point-depth ownership.

patches.title: Key point style shader caches by their generation arguments
patches.reason: Sharing one Cesium3DTileStyle between Model pnts and independent PointCloud reuses incompatible cached GLSL signatures. Invalidate each shader-function cache when its function signature or variable substitution map changes, preserving existing style-change invalidation and translucent metadata.
patches.removalCondition: Native style shader caching distinguishes function signatures and variable substitutions.

patches.title: Bind owned deferred material array layers and samplers
patches.reason: Four separate extended-material samplers exhaust the WebGL2 fragment limit with native feature styling, physical environment and diagnostic tint. Owned RGBA16F array storage preserves attachment count, precision, bytes and draw submissions; only layer attachment and sampler binding require upstream seams.
patches.removalCondition: Native framebuffer and uniform APIs support equivalent borrowed texture-array layers.

patches.title: Select owned AgX in the native HDR display slot
patches.reason: Expose AgX through the existing Tonemapper API and reuse native exposure, grading and display-stage lifecycle without a second post-process pass.
patches.removalCondition: Native Tonemapper supplies equivalent linear-sRGB AgX with compatible exposure, grading and LDR behavior.

patches.title: Keep Draco Node filesystem imports external in browser workers
patches.reason: Draco 1.5.9 uses require('node:fs') in its guarded Node branch. The native browser worker bundler only excludes bare fs and path, so fresh installs allowed by the existing dependency range fail during buildEngine. Extend only the confirmed external name without changing the browser platform or decoder.
patches.removalCondition: The upstream worker bundler accepts Draco's guarded node:fs import, or the dependency no longer includes that Node branch.

patches.title: Load native GeoJSON into an explicit planar world
patches.reason: ADR-0172 adds an instance-bound planar load context, explicit per-coordinate projection, straight edges and explicit ground polygon height semantics. The native parser, styling, entities, events and globe defaults remain shared; projection validation and display gating stay SceneGIS-owned.
patches.removalCondition: Native GeoJsonDataSource provides equivalent instance-local world-coordinate loading and explicit planar geometry semantics.

patches.title: Bind native CZML to an explicit planar world
patches.reason: ADR-0173 reuses native CZML temporal parsing with an instance-local fixed meter-coordinate policy and validates the bound World before display updates, including Globe misuse.
patches.removalCondition: Native CZML and DataSourceDisplay provide equivalent instance-bound planar coordinates and World validation.

patches.title: Bind unsigned integer Gaussian texture arrays
patches.reason: Segmented Gaussian Core and SH pages use RGBA32UI arrays. Dispatch the native unsigned integer array uniform type to the existing UniformSampler without a second binding system.
patches.removalCondition: Native uniform dispatch supports UNSIGNED_INT_SAMPLER_2D_ARRAY.
